scope: local mocks only; no remote creation or cleanup executed
networkGuard: global fetch rejects all requests in selftest
checks: fresh DEMO replays concurrently, conflicts are genuine, cleanup preserves the original three and Auth
a lost creation response is retried with the same request ID and cleaned once
pending responses reuse the same request until a terminal result
an unconfirmed active worker keeps the journal and forbids cleanup races
a failed assertion still cleans the completed temporary restaurant
an Auth marker changed by another actor prevents every delete
an additional owner membership prevents deletion of that account or restaurant
failure deleting a restricted sale prevents restaurant and Auth deletion
Auth delete failure retains exact recovery identifiers after restaurant cleanup
a fourth pre-existing restaurant fails before mutation
journal durability failure prevents the first network mutation
Auth pagination reads beyond 200 users without truncating or leaking records
service deletion predicates require exact sale, tenant and owner identifiers
a prior pending journal prevents treating an orphan account as a fresh baseline
a journal with another target or format cannot authorize a new audit
limitations: A nonterminal creation worker or changed ownership preserves the encrypted journal and requires reconciliation before another run.
Durable creation requests and security audit events are retained; temporary restaurant, sale and Auth cleanup is verified separately.
